name: Bangsaen42 (Bangsaen Marathon)
short_description: Bangsaen42 is a full-marathon event at Bang Saen Beach, Chonburi, Thailand, scheduled for November 15, 2026.
ai_summary: Bangsaen42 (Bangsaen Marathon) is a marathon scheduled for Sunday 15 November 2026, starting and finishing on the beach road in front of the Bangsaen Heritage Hotel in Bang Saen, Chonburi, Thailand. It is a single-distance race over 42.195 km, organised by MICE & Communication with the Chonburi Provincial Administrative Organisation and Saen Suk Municipality. The 2026 race is its tenth edition.

core_facts.organizer: MICE & Communication, with the Chonburi Provincial Administrative Organisation and Saen Suk Municipality
core_facts.venue: Bang Saen Beach, in front of the Bangsaen Heritage Hotel

pros: Marathon only, on roads fully closed to traffic
Certified course with a World Athletics Elite Label
Water about every 2 km and a seven-hour limit from the last wave
Big field (9,729 finishers in 2025) with King Kong awards for the first 100 men and women
cons: Very humid before dawn: 27°C and 94% humidity at the 2025 start
Five intermediate cut-offs enforced on the clock
Wave starts at 2.30am to 3am, with the start line closing at 3.10am
Late climb at Khao Sam Muk after the coastal out-and-back

faqs.question: When is Bangsaen42 (Bangsaen Marathon) taking place?
faqs.answer: Bangsaen42, also known as the Bangsaen Marathon, is on Sunday 15 November 2026. It starts and finishes on the beach road in front of the Bangsaen Heritage Hotel in Bang Saen, Chonburi, Thailand, with waves starting at 2.30am, 2.45am and 3am. Bib pickup is on 13 and 14 November, not on race day.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at Bangsaen42?
faqs.answer: Bangsaen42 is a marathon only: the one distance is 42.195 km, and the organiser says it will always stage a single-distance marathon. There is no half marathon or 10 km on race day. Bangsaen21, a separate half marathon from the same organiser, is held in Bang Saen in December.

faqs.question: Who organises Bangsaen42?
faqs.answer: Bangsaen42 is organised by MICE & Communication, with the Chonburi Provincial Administrative Organisation and Saen Suk Municipality as hosts. The course is certified and measured in cooperation with AIMS, and the race holds a World Athletics Elite Label, which it first gained in 2021. Saen Suk Municipality closed the roads fully for the 2025 race.
